_doc: Twenty questions phrased the way Nic asks Brain Home for something, each naming the fixture record ID(s) in records.json that should come back. Used by tests/benchmarks/test_recall.py (a fixture snapshot through FakeGitHub) and by gremlin_town.benchmarks.recall_cli (the same questions against a live hub, read-only). To add a question: pick (or write) a fixture record in records.json with a distinctive word in its title (title hits rank above body-only hits in memory.search's real ranking - see github_brain_provider.py _search), phrase the question the way Nic actually would, list every record ID in the fixture set that would be a correct answer (a question can have more than one), and give it a short unique id below. Keep 'preference' records out of expected_record_ids: memory.search's snapshot only covers capture/commitment/item/fact kinds, so a preference is never returned today (documented in docs/mcp/everyday-brain-core.md).
